title: Page title is "About Skyline Design"
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the browser tab / document title
expected_result: Document title is exactly "About Skyline Design".

title: Hero heading text is visible on load
test_data: Hero text: Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass.
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Look at the hero block at the top of the page
expected_result: The hero text "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." is visible, fully opaque and not clipped or overlapped by the header.

title: Page has a single non-empty H1 containing the hero text
test_data: Expected H1: Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass.
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Inspect the page headings and count elements with tag h1
Read the text content of the h1
expected_result: Exactly one <h1> exists and its text is "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." (currently the h1 is empty and the hero text is in a <div> — confirmed defect).

title: Meta description is present and not empty
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the content attribute of meta[name="description"] in the page head
expected_result: A meta description tag exists and its content is a non-empty, human-readable sentence (not a placeholder such as "Just another WordPress site").

title: Canonical URL points to the dev /about/ page
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the href of link[rel="canonical"] in the page head
expected_result: Canonical link equals https://dev.skyline.glass/about/ (no query string, includes trailing slash).

title: Hero text reaches full opacity after the load animation
test_data: Wait times: immediately after load, then 3 seconds later
steps: Navigate to /about/ and immediately observe the hero text
Wait 3 seconds and observe the hero text again
expected_result: Hero text may be faint right after load, but after about 2-3 seconds it is fully opaque (computed opacity 1) and stays visible.

title: Page loads without console errors
steps: Open the browser console, then navigate to /about/ and wait for load
expected_result: Page returns HTTP 200 and the console contains 0 errors on initial load. Known warnings (GSAP "target not found", manifest start_url, deprecated apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta) are not failures.
